From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-23T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: BeaconHealth — privacy execution plan and signature routing

Marissa / Ben —

I reviewed BeaconHealth's scope. Key redline recommendations (high level):
1) Data residency: tighten to allow subprocessor transfer but require notice + right to object for EU/UK personal data.
2) Retention: offer a default 2-year retention clause but accept a 6-month exception for aggregated analytics if BeaconHealth needs shorter.
3) SCCs: we will append the EU SCC module and provide a completed SCCs_matrix for mappings (see attached).
4) HIPAA/BAA: add standard BAA addendum as Exhibit B. We should confirm whether PHI will be sent to hosted (shared) vs. dedicated/private deployment — this impacts indemnity and segmentation language.

Routing: recommend DocuSign envelope with signer order: BeaconHealth -> Redwood Legal (me) -> Redwood CFO (finance@redwood.com). I attached my redline and SCCs matrix.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Privacy Counsel
Redwood Inference

Attachments: BH_DPA_redline_neha_20270923.docx; SCCs_matrix_20270923.xlsx

Attached is Redwood's redline per Neha's notes (same doc). A few practical items for your procurement team:

Thanks, the redline looks thorough. A couple of procurement comments:

- Also need a CAIQ/consensus export. Can you expedite?

We prefer BeaconHealth signs first; our legal will countersign after Redwood CFO. Please confirm final signer names for the DocuSign envelope.
